exchange.sent: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not support an AI-specific ranked list of the “most important” signal generation capabilities; the AI infrastructure passages identify Connectivity, Power and Resilience, not signal-generator feature priorities [40][42].
### Supported signal-generation capabilities in the passages
- Wide RF/mmWave frequency coverage is supported by R&S signal-generator passages, including SMW200A RF path A up to 100 kHz to 67 GHz and overrange 67 GHz to 72 GHz, and MWC2025 signal-generation listings up to 67 GHz for SMA100B and SMW200A [96][47].  
- Wide modulation / signal bandwidth is supported by passages citing SMW200A wideband baseband up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth and early 6G research mentioning up to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth and up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth [94][47].  
- Arbitrary waveform generation and large waveform memory are supported by passages citing ARB capabilities such as SMW200A waveform length up to 256 Msample, extendable to 2 Gsample, and CMX500 ARB sample length up to 1.5 Gsample with maximum sample rate 1.25 GHz and maximum possible RF bandwidth 1 GHz [94][8].  
- Waveform replay and creation are supported by CMX500 GPRF Generator passages listing ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF Generator instances in parallel, ARB Sequencer, and replay from IQ capture, MATLAB or other sources [5][6].  
- Internal real-time signal generation and digital-standard signal generation are supported by SMM100A and SMBV100B passages listing internal real-time signal generation, ARB, custom digital modulation, 5G NR FR1/FR2 support, and internal signal generation for major digital communications standards [16][45].  
- Multichannel, MIMO and fading/channel emulation are supported by SMW200A passages stating support for up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8 and 2x4x4 [22].  
- Dynamic propagation impairment generation is supported by NTN passages stating that SMW200A can be equipped with a fading emulator for TDL/CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay and path loss, and that SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss and weather-induced attenuation [49].  
- Clean RF performance is supported by SMM100A passages listing excellent SSB phase noise, EVM and ACPR/ACLR performance, and SMW200A passages listing ultra-low phase-noise options with specified examples at 1 GHz and 67 GHz [16][96].  
- Impairment and noise generation is supported by passages listing AWGN options or capabilities, including SMBV100B AWGN with settable bandwidth and C/N or Eb/N0, SMCV100B additive white Gaussian noise, and CMX500 technology-specific AWGN license entry CMX-KW120 [21][62][69].

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[R&S SMB100B]]、[[R&S SMA100B]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz signal generator 產品；本來源描述的是 vector signal generator，重點在 internal baseband/I/Q、digital standards、GNSS/avionics 與 waveform generation。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[R&S SGT100A]] 同樣涵蓋 RF source / vector signal generation 類產品，但 SMBV100B 來源列出更完整的 front panel / rear panel、baseband generator、digital standards、GNSS 與 legacy command emulation。
- 本來源屬 `Productions`，只整理產品規格、options、order numbers 與文件版次；不延伸市場採用狀態，也不解釋各無線標準本身。

SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301 › 重點摘要
- 文件：R&S®SMBV100B Vector Signal Generator Specifications。
- 來源檔名：`SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301.pdf`。
- 文件編號與版次：PD 3607.8201.22，Version 13.01，August 2025（footer 標示 August 2025 (la)）。
- 產品：[[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator。
- Base unit：R&S®SMBV100B，Order No. 1423.1003.02；內含 baseband generator with ARB（64 Msamples、120 MHz RF bandwidth）、power cable、quick start guide。
- Base unit 只能搭配 R&S®SMBVB-B103 frequency option 訂購。
- 頻率範圍依 option：
  - with R&S®SMBVB-B103：CW mode 8 kHz to 3 GHz；I/Q mode 1 MHz to 3 GHz。
  - with R&S®SMBVB-B103 and R&S®SMBVBKB106：CW mode 8 kHz to 6 GHz；I/Q mode 1 MHz to 6 GHz。
- R&S®SMBV100B 支援最高 1 GHz RF modulation bandwidth；ARB / baseband extension options 對應 120 MHz、240 MHz、500 MHz、1000 MHz RF bandwidth 等級。
- 輸出功率：文件概述稱最高輸出功率可達 +33 dBm；ordering 與 RF level 表格中，R&S®SMBVB-B32 ultra high output power 的 level setting range 在 1 MHz ≤ f ≤ 6 GHz 可設定至 +36 dBm，specified level range 在 10 MHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 可到 +25 dBm。
- 規格表涵蓋 RF characteristics、simultaneous modulation、analog modulation、sources for analog modulation、I/Q modulation、baseband characteristics、baseband enhancements、digital modulation systems、signal performance、HUMS、remote control、connectors、general data、ordering information、warranty and service。
- 介面與操作：7-inch color capacitive touchscreen、context-sensitive help system、SCPI recording、remote control、user data protection。
- 支援 internal real-time signal generation 與 internal signal generation for major digital communications standards；internal digital standards 需 R&S®SMBVB-K520 option，個別 standard 另有 R&S®SMBVB-Kxxx options。
- 支援 GNSS simulator options：GPS、GLONASS、Galileo、BeiDou、QZSS/SBAS 等；詳細規格參照 GNSS and Avionics Simulation for Rohde & Schwarz Signal Generators specifications（PD 3607.6896.22）。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Spectrum、mmWave 與 early 6G research
- Slide 10 以 `More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies` 連到 transition to 6G 的 RF performance demand。
- Signal generation 產品列名包括 [[R&S SMA100B]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMW200A]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMB100A]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S SMM100A]] up to 44 GHz、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 3/6 GHz，以及 [[R&S SFI]]、[[FE110ST]]、[[FE170ST]]、[[FC330ST]]、[[FC500ST]] 等 frequency converter / front end。

- Throughput 必須大於或等於 reference measurement channel maximum throughput 的 95%。

### Short answer
The passages do not support an AI-specific ranked list of the “most important” signal generation capabilities; the AI infrastructure passages identify Connectivity, Power and Resilience, not signal-generator feature priorities [40][42].
### Supported signal-generation capabilities in the passages
- Wide RF/mmWave frequency coverage is supported by R&S signal-generator passages, including SMW200A RF path A up to 100 kHz to 67 GHz and overrange 67 GHz to 72 GHz, and MWC2025 signal-generation listings up to 67 GHz for SMA100B and SMW200A [96][47].  
- Wide modulation / signal bandwidth is supported by passages citing SMW200A wideband baseband up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth and early 6G research mentioning up to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth and up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth [94][47].  
- Arbitrary waveform generation and large waveform memory are supported by passages citing ARB capabilities such as SMW200A waveform length up to 256 Msample, extendable to 2 Gsample, and CMX500 ARB sample length up to 1.5 Gsample with maximum sample rate 1.25 GHz and maximum possible RF bandwidth 1 GHz [94][8].  
- Waveform replay and creation are supported by CMX500 GPRF Generator passages listing ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF Generator instances in parallel, ARB Sequencer, and replay from IQ capture, MATLAB or other sources [5][6].  
- Internal real-time signal generation and digital-standard signal generation are supported by SMM100A and SMBV100B passages listing internal real-time signal generation, ARB, custom digital modulation, 5G NR FR1/FR2 support, and internal signal generation for major digital communications standards [16][45].  
- Multichannel, MIMO and fading/channel emulation are supported by SMW200A passages stating support for up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8 and 2x4x4 [22].  
- Dynamic propagation impairment generation is supported by NTN passages stating that SMW200A can be equipped with a fading emulator for TDL/CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay and path loss, and that SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss and weather-induced attenuation [49].

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。

SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301 › 讀圖補充
以下來自讀圖，可信度低於正文；不應用來推翻正文。

![[SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301-p001.png]]

- p001 封面可辨識文字：R&S®SMBV100B、VECTOR SIGNAL GENERATOR、Specifications、Version 13.01、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real。
- p001 圖片內容：封面含儀器產品照片、左上標題、下半部深灰幾何底圖、左下品牌名稱與標語、右下公司標誌。
- p001 儀器螢幕可辨識文字與數值：ROHDE&SCHWARZ、SMBV100B、Vector Signal Generator、Frequency、4.000 000 000 000 Hz、7.50 dB、5.00 ms；7.50 dB 與 5.00 ms 的欄位名稱無法完整辨識。
- p001 螢幕畫面不是曲線圖，而是功能方塊／訊號流程介面；方塊名稱、完整連線關係、前面板按鍵文字、前面板接頭旁小標示、螢幕下方狀態列與其他小字多數無法辨識。

SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[R&S SMB100B]]、[[R&S SMA100B]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz signal generator 產品；本來源描述的是 vector signal generator，重點在 internal baseband/I/Q、digital standards、GNSS/avionics 與 waveform generation。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[R&S SGT100A]] 同樣涵蓋 RF source / vector signal generation 類產品，但 SMBV100B 來源列出更完整的 front panel / rear panel、baseband generator、digital standards、GNSS 與 legacy command emulation。
- 本來源屬 `Productions`，只整理產品規格、options、order numbers 與文件版次；不延伸市場採用狀態，也不解釋各無線標準本身。

SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301 › 重點摘要
- 文件：R&S®SMBV100B Vector Signal Generator Specifications。
- 來源檔名：`SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301.pdf`。
- 文件編號與版次：PD 3607.8201.22，Version 13.01，August 2025（footer 標示 August 2025 (la)）。
- 產品：[[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator。
- Base unit：R&S®SMBV100B，Order No. 1423.1003.02；內含 baseband generator with ARB（64 Msamples、120 MHz RF bandwidth）、power cable、quick start guide。
- Base unit 只能搭配 R&S®SMBVB-B103 frequency option 訂購。
- 頻率範圍依 option：
  - with R&S®SMBVB-B103：CW mode 8 kHz to 3 GHz；I/Q mode 1 MHz to 3 GHz。
  - with R&S®SMBVB-B103 and R&S®SMBVBKB106：CW mode 8 kHz to 6 GHz；I/Q mode 1 MHz to 6 GHz。
- R&S®SMBV100B 支援最高 1 GHz RF modulation bandwidth；ARB / baseband extension options 對應 120 MHz、240 MHz、500 MHz、1000 MHz RF bandwidth 等級。
- 輸出功率：文件概述稱最高輸出功率可達 +33 dBm；ordering 與 RF level 表格中，R&S®SMBVB-B32 ultra high output power 的 level setting range 在 1 MHz ≤ f ≤ 6 GHz 可設定至 +36 dBm，specified level range 在 10 MHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 可到 +25 dBm。
- 規格表涵蓋 RF characteristics、simultaneous modulation、analog modulation、sources for analog modulation、I/Q modulation、baseband characteristics、baseband enhancements、digital modulation systems、signal performance、HUMS、remote control、connectors、general data、ordering information、warranty and service。
- 介面與操作：7-inch color capacitive touchscreen、context-sensitive help system、SCPI recording、remote control、user data protection。
- 支援 internal real-time signal generation 與 internal signal generation for major digital communications standards；internal digital standards 需 R&S®SMBVB-K520 option，個別 standard 另有 R&S®SMBVB-Kxxx options。
- 支援 GNSS simulator options：GPS、GLONASS、Galileo、BeiDou、QZSS/SBAS 等；詳細規格參照 GNSS and Avionics Simulation for Rohde & Schwarz Signal Generators specifications（PD 3607.6896.22）。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Spectrum、mmWave 與 early 6G research
- Slide 10 以 `More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies` 連到 transition to 6G 的 RF performance demand。
- Signal generation 產品列名包括 [[R&S SMA100B]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMW200A]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMB100A]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S SMM100A]] up to 44 GHz、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 3/6 GHz，以及 [[R&S SFI]]、[[FE110ST]]、[[FE170ST]]、[[FC330ST]]、[[FC500ST]] 等 frequency converter / front end。
- Spectrum analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S FSW]] up to 90 GHz、[[R&S FSVA3050]] up to 50/54 GHz、[[R&S FPS]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S PVT360A]] / [[R&S CMP200]]、[[FE44S]]、[[FE50DTR]]、[[FC330SR]] 等。
- Network analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S ZNA]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] up to 110 GHz、[[R&S ZNB]]、[[R&S ZVA]] 10 MHz–110 GHz，以及 banded mmW converters up to 1.1 THz。
- Slide 13 early 6G research 提到 up-to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth、up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth、generic OFDM analysis、4096QAM / multi-modulation 與 flat signals over entire frequency range。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › 原文未解的問題
- 來源是 PowerPoint 轉成 markdown 的 lossy derivative；圖片、圖表位置、產品照片與部分連線圖細節可能遺失。
- 正式發布日期只可確認 MWC 2025 語境；簡報版次、作者與文件代碼未標示。
- `COMPANY RESTRICTED` 標示代表使用時需注意資料分類；本 ingest 只保留來源內容，不推論可公開散布範圍。
- `All 38.141 measurements supported` 是簡報層級 solution claim，未提供完整 test case matrix、option code、release version、calibration accessories 或正式 compliance statement。
- [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] 的 RF bands 29 / 39 / 47、QDART validation、parallel DUT testing 與 path correction 為簡報說法，仍需 datasheet 或 production test 文件補證。
- [[O-RU testing]] 的 O-RAN WG4 Conformance Specifications 未標示版本、profile、test case IDs、certification authority 或 option code。
- [[ETSI ES 202 706-1]] energy efficiency testing 未標示版本與適用 O-RU / base station 類型。
- 早期 6G 研究的 4 GHz / 8 GHz bandwidth、4096QAM / generic OFDM analysis 未指定產品型號、測試條件、頻段或標準版本。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation
[[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中描述的 end-to-end NTN system testing 方法：用 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 fading / channel emulation 功能模擬 service link 與 feeder link 的 RF satellite link，並透過 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 或 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 產生 trajectory-based fading files。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › E2E system testing 架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 24，E2E system testing 圖中包含：

- UE。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- NTN payload。
- Channel emulator for feeder link。
- 圖上另標示兩組 2 paths。

來源將此歸為 [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 End-to-end System Testing 類別。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › 使用限制
- 來源為 2025 簡報，不是 [[R&S SMW200A]] specifications 或 fading option datasheet。
- dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 數字需回查正式 SMW200A fading specifications 與 relevant application note。
- slide 28 多個欄位空白或無法可靠辨識；本頁不補推 missing values。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 的正式 version、license、ordering information、output file format、trajectory source、supported orbit 與 availability 條件未標示。
- 此頁不等同 [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 中 CMX500 PR 對 propagation emulation / fading 的術語區分。

R&S PVT360A O-RU testing › 使用限制
- 本頁是 Market / solution positioning，不是 [[R&S PVT360A]] 規格頁。
- PVT360A 的正式 RF unit、frequency、bandwidth、option dependencies 與 order number 仍以 [[PVT360A_Features_V8-5-30_en_06]]、specifications document 與 R&S configuration tool 為準。
- 來源未列 PVT360A O-RU test suite 的 test case IDs、software version、license prerequisites、automation framework、calibration / uncertainty 或 pass / fail limits。
- PVT360A 支援 O-RAN WG4 / 3GPP subset 的說法不能直接等同完整 O-RAN certification 或 3GPP conformance qualification。
- MWC 2025 demo 是 demonstration context，不等同正式產品化測試流程或客戶導入證據。

R&S PVT360A O-RU testing › Hardware / software configuration line items
依來源 Slide 10，PVT360A 以外的 reusable hardware configuration 包含：

- O-RAN 5G FR1 signal generation：[[R&S SMBV100B]] 6 GHz / 120 MHz 或 [[R&S SMM100A]] 7.5 GHz / 240 MHz。
- O-RAN 5G FR1 incl. BF tests：dual-path [[R&S SMW200A]] 6 GHz / 500 MHz / phase coherent。
- O-RAN 5G FR1 + 3GPP Conformance Ch. 6 / Ch. 7：dual-path [[R&S SMW200A]] 12 and 6 GHz / 500 MHz / AWGN。
- Signal analysis：[[R&S FSV3000]] 7 GHz / 200 MHz、[[R&S FSVA3000]] 7 GHz / 200 or 400 MHz；depending on frequency band [[R&S FSV3030]] / [[R&S FSVA3030]] 30 GHz variants。
- Upgrade to FR2：[[R&S FE44S]]、[[R&S FE50DTR]] with [[R&S SMM100A]] / [[R&S SMW200A]] base unit + K553 software option；analysis side requires [[R&S FSVA3000]] or [[R&S FSW]] base unit + K553 software option。

R&S PVT360A O-RU testing › 來源中的定位
依 [[R-S-portfolio-for-O-RU-testing_MARCH_2025_R-S_INTERNAL_ONLY_SHORT]]（March 2025）：

- PVT360A test setup 被放在 `Which system should I offer for O-RU testing?` 的 decision table 中，和 standalone VSA/VSG setup 對照。

- Ideal for regression and release testing，ensuring consistency and reliability across development stages。
- Ideal for MNOs looking to perform quality checks on delivered O-RUs。
- PVT360 or PVT360+ with high output power are described as ideal for small cell or macro-cell production testing，and can support testing of two O-RUs simultaneously。

### Short answer
The passages do not support an AI-specific ranked list of the “most important” signal generation capabilities; the AI infrastructure passages identify Connectivity, Power and Resilience, not signal-generator feature priorities [40][42].
### Supported signal-generation capabilities in the passages
- Wide RF/mmWave frequency coverage is supported by R&S signal-generator passages, including SMW200A RF path A up to 100 kHz to 67 GHz and overrange 67 GHz to 72 GHz, and MWC2025 signal-generation listings up to 67 GHz for SMA100B and SMW200A [96][47].  
- Wide modulation / signal bandwidth is supported by passages citing SMW200A wideband baseband up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth and early 6G research mentioning up to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth and up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth [94][47].  
- Arbitrary waveform generation and large waveform memory are supported by passages citing ARB capabilities such as SMW200A waveform length up to 256 Msample, extendable to 2 Gsample, and CMX500 ARB sample length up to 1.5 Gsample with maximum sample rate 1.25 GHz and maximum possible RF bandwidth 1 GHz [94][8].  
- Waveform replay and creation are supported by CMX500 GPRF Generator passages listing ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF Generator instances in parallel, ARB Sequencer, and replay from IQ capture, MATLAB or other sources [5][6].  
- Internal real-time signal generation and digital-standard signal generation are supported by SMM100A and SMBV100B passages listing internal real-time signal generation, ARB, custom digital modulation, 5G NR FR1/FR2 support, and internal signal generation for major digital communications standards [16][45].  
- Multichannel, MIMO and fading/channel emulation are supported by SMW200A passages stating support for up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8 and 2x4x4 [22].  
- Dynamic propagation impairment generation is supported by NTN passages stating that SMW200A can be equipped with a fading emulator for TDL/CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay and path loss, and that SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss and weather-induced attenuation [49].  
- Clean RF performance is supported by SMM100A passages listing excellent SSB phase noise, EVM and ACPR/ACLR performance, and SMW200A passages listing ultra-low phase-noise options with specified examples at 1 GHz and 67 GHz [16][96].  
- Impairment and noise generation is supported by passages listing AWGN options or capabilities, including SMBV100B AWGN with settable bandwidth and C/N or Eb/N0, SMCV100B additive white Gaussian noise, and CMX500 technology-specific AWGN license entry CMX-KW120 [21][62][69].

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。

- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。

- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。
